title: workflow-store + state-projection port (enables the state-sync hook)
action: Port workflow-store (workflow record CRUD: create/list/update, per-workflow locking semantics) and state-projection (projectionsAuthoritative :106, workflowGatesToApprovedGates :132 incl. the plan_rev effectiveness rule, pickNewestActiveWorkflow :149, rebuildStateProjection :210, rebuildLaneProjection :302 incl. the ad-hoc field pass-through for last_scribing_run/gate_revoked_at/advisor_ref, rebuildHandoffProjection :382, rebuildAllProjections :453). REUSE, do not re-port: the D9 lock module is already at crates/bee-core/src/lock.rs (cross-runtime interop precedent: crates/bee-core/tests/lock_interop.rs) and controlRootFor is already at crates/bee-core/src/workspace.rs — workflow-store.mjs imports it rather than defining it. Writes go through bee-core fsutil atomic primitives under the same locks node takes — a projection rebuild is a read-modify-write and must not race the mjs CLI (D9). ORACLE DISCIPLINE: rebuilds are diffed against the real mjs modules over identical fixture stores (node rebuilds root A, rust rebuilds root B, resulting files compared after volatile normalization), including the ad-hoc-field pass-through fixture and a no-workflow-record fixture (authoritative false, no file deleted). Cross-runtime interop fixture: node holds the workflow lock while rust attempts a rebuild and vice versa. ALL tests in ONE target projection_parity.

truths: cargo --test projection_parity runs and reports at least 12 passed
rust rebuild output files are byte-equal to the mjs rebuild on the same fixture after volatile normalization, incl. ad-hoc field pass-through and the no-record no-op case
cross-runtime lock interop: neither runtime rebuilds while the other holds the workflow lock

artifacts.substantive: workflow-store CRUD plus state-projection rebuilds with projection_parity oracle target

key_links: locking reuses crates/bee-core/src/lock.rs; controlRootFor reuses crates/bee-core/src/workspace.rs
prohibitions: No edits to .bee/bin/ or packages/bee/ (D1 freeze)
Tests never touch the live .bee/ store
No edits to crates/Cargo.toml members list
